leadText: Pocket Monsters DP (Japanese: ポケットモンスターD・P編) is a shōnen Pokémon manga created by Kosaku Anakubo. It is a sequel to the Pokémon Pocket Monsters and Pokémon Ruby-Sapphire manga series and is succeeded by . The plot follows the adventures of and his Pokémon ( , and ) in Sinnoh. It is chiefly a gag manga using crude humor and slapstick.
